$label: Boardroom · light, soft corners, heavy chassis
$description: Shows STRUCTURAL branding, not just colour. `$shape: "soft"` rounds the rectangular surfaces (--radius 6px) and `$weight: "heavy"` thickens borders and deepens the hard shadows. Surfaces come from `$ramp`; on-colours are auto-derived. Any chassis token can also be set explicitly (e.g. "row-h") — those win over the presets. Build → dist/themes/boardroom.css.
